title: Restoring a wall painting
bodyMd: A conservator leaves a small damaged area of a wall painting unfilled. Reconstructing it would require guessing the original image. Visitors ask why a restoration remains visibly incomplete. She explains that stabilizing the surviving paint and inventing missing details are different activities. A nearby digital display shows two possible reconstructions, each clearly labelled as hypothetical.
